The AI-native decision layer for sport.
Football experts should be doing football work. Marquee gives you 70% of your time back, so you can spend it on what only you can do: the footballing decision.
About Us
Marquee turns football data into decision-ready insights in seconds, unifying external and internal data and filtering it through each club's sporting DNA. Professional clubs use Marquee for recruitment, squad planning and analytics.
Marquee was built inside the game, not around it. From day one, practitioners in recruitment departments across the Premier League, Serie A, the Eredivisie and MLS shaped what the platform does and how it does it. Every model was tested against the way real clubs actually work, by the people who do the work.
Built by Experts, for Experts
The Problem
Clubs spend $3.5B a year on data, and a recruitment department still loses most of its week to manual work. Over half of transfers fail anyway.
The Solution
An AI-native decision layer that unifies scattered data and filters every answer through your club's sporting DNA.
The Outcome
No data collection, no black boxes. Just clean, instant insights so experts can get back to the game.
